# TradeIndia

> > India's largest B2B marketplace connecting 10M+ manufacturers, exporters, and suppliers with buyers for seamless trade and business growth.

TradeIndia is a comprehensive B2B platform that enables businesses to post products, source suppliers, and access trade opportunities across India. The platform serves MSMEs and large enterprises with free and premium seller packages, integrated payment solutions, and connections to major trade shows and exhibitions.

## Key Topics

- B2B Marketplace
- Manufacturers & Exporters
- Supplier Directory
- Trade Leads
- Product Posting
- Buy Requirements
- Seller Verification
- MSME Packages
- TradeIndia Pay
- TradeIndia App
- GST Compliance
- Business Growth
- Free Account
- Bulk Buying
- Trade Shows & Exhibitions

## Core Platform

- [TradeIndia - B2B Marketplace for Top Manufacturers, Exporters, Suppliers](https://www.tradeindia.com): TradeIndia homepage: India's largest B2B marketplace with 10M+ users
- [Sign Up - Create your account for free at TradeIndia](https://www.tradeindia.com/join_now/verification.html): User registration and account creation for TradeIndia B2B platform
- [India B2B Directory - Connect with Suppliers & Grow Your Business](https://www.tradeindia.com/seller): B2B directory of verified suppliers, manufacturers, exporters across India

## Buying & Sourcing

- [Lookingfor a ProductPost BuyRequirementPost YourRequirement](https://www.tradeindia.com/post-buy-requirement): Post buy requirements and sourcing requests on TradeIndia marketplace

## Seller Tools & Resources

- [Post & Promote Your Products at No Cost](https://www.tradeindia.com/join_now/upload_product.html): Guide to posting and promoting products as seller on TradeIndia
- [Tradeindia Special Packages for MSMEs - Boost Your Business Online](https://www.tradeindia.com/special-offers.html): MSME seller packages and subscription plans with digital marketing services

## Trade Events & Exhibitions

- [Trade Shows in 2026 - 2027 - Exhibitions, Trade Fairs, Expos in India](https://www.tradeindia.com/tradeshows): Directory of trade shows, exhibitions, and B2B events in India 2026-2027
